name: Hotel Royal Riviera
positioning: The Royal-Riviera: a hotel on the Cap-Ferrat peninsula with beach access, overlooking Provencal gardens and the Mediterranean
best_for: Families who want a heated pool, a sandy beach and connecting suites on the Riviera
Travelers who want a quiet Cap-Ferrat base with sea and garden views

facts.text: Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat is an old fishing village that became a seaside and winter resort sought after for its serenity.
The rooms are designed to reflect the landscape of the south of France, and most of them overlook the sea and gardens.
A private villa, l'Orangerie, holds additional rooms and suites decorated in Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat style.
The Orangerie deluxe rooms all have either a balcony or a terrace.
Junior Suites with a panoramic sea view have a large marble bathroom with natural daylight and a separate bath and shower.
The hotel has a fitness area with a sauna and steam room.
Water sports at the beach are offered by the hotel's partner, Cap-Ferrat Watersports.
Buckets and spades are available at the hotel's private beach.
Sights in the village include the port, the 18th-century Chapelle Sainte-Hospice and the Vierge Noire.

highlights.text: The hotel sits on the Cap-Ferrat peninsula with access to the beach and overlooks Provencal gardens, mountains and the Mediterranean sea.
The outdoor pool is free for hotel guests and has a pool bar where guests can sip a cocktail with their feet in the water.
Children aged 7 to 12 can join a treasure hunt at the Villa Ephrussi de Rothschild.
Jasmin Grill & Lounge is centered around a wood-fired grill.
The Wellness Center offers treatments from the THALGO marine range.

considerations.text: The hotel's sandy beach is open only from mid-May to the end of September.
There is no kids' club; children's activities are not supervised by hotel staff.
WhataHotel notes limited parking availability due to the historic peninsula setting.
